reflexium.title: Reflexium
reflexium.option.reflex_mode.tooltip:
Lowers input latency by letting the driver start each frame just in time for the GPU.

On + Boost also keeps GPU clocks high when the CPU is the bottleneck.
reflexium.option.frame_limiter.tooltip: While Reflex is on, enforce Max Framerate with the Reflex sleep instead of vanilla's limiter. Lower latency at the same cap.
reflexium.option.dlss_detection.tooltip: Enables the Vulkan extensions DLSS needs and checks driver and feature DLL readiness (shown in F3). Upscaling itself is not implemented yet. Applies after a restart.
reflexium.option.status.tooltip: Shows the live Reflex, DLSS and shader loader status.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.reflexium: NVIDIA Reflex low latency for Minecraft's Vulkan renderer, with DLSS readiness checks.
